doc.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008

title: Touring Sweden with Dakota in 1977
summary: He toured Scandinavia with Dakota, who had emotional problems throughout her life.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So getting back to Dakota, you went overseas with her, in the seventies?
That was delightful. As a matter of fact I have a recording that we did, we did a T.V. show and it was in a small town in Sweden. I still have that. It was a nice tour. A nice tour.
How did she feel about her career? Was she happy with, you know, the way it went?
Well Dakota had emotional problems all through her life. So it was up and down. It was hard to — there were times when she was up, and times when she was down.
